about: A swap with a wild Pokemon lasts (Pokemon Central, Rapidscambio), and the item handed over goes to the bag when the wild Pokemon is beaten (Raggiro, from the ninth generation). On Route 29 the Cyndaquil starts the battle holding a Silk Scarf and is taught Trick and Water Gun; the forced wild Geodude holds an Everstone (set:, teach:). The Trick swaps the two, Water Gun beats the Geodude, and back on the field the Cyndaquil holds the Everstone and the bag has the Silk Scarf -- where before the Cyndaquil had its Silk Scarf back and the Everstone went to the bag. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
